result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall with a consistent food-delivery layout. One minor styling inconsistency was noted with the favorite (heart) icons across cards.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons are styled inconsistently between the two 'Popular right now' cards. The ramen card uses a white/outline heart with no background, while the pizza card uses a heart on a dark filled circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon treatment (same background container and icon style) across all cards for visual consistency.
